title: Niagara Falls View, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo, Canada
description: A black and white vintage snapshot taken on June 13, 1949, depicting a distant scenic overlook of Niagara Falls from the Canadian side. Dense foliage and treetops fill the lower foreground, leading across the river to the mist-shrouded, powerful torrents of the falls. During the post-World War II era, Niagara Falls remained one of the premier vacation and honeymoon destinations in North America.
